# Deadlift form

## Why I deadlift at all
Pilar cleared me after the back strain ([[Lower back pain]]) and said the best way to stop being scared of lifting patients is to get strong at lifting things properly. So since February 2025, Wednesday evenings at the West End YMCA, with three 1:1 sessions from Rafael Mendonça ($75 each) to learn it right. Conventional barbell deadlift, not sumo.

## Setup checklist
1. Bar over midfoot, about 2.5 cm from the shins. Shoelaces are my reference, the bar sits over the second eyelet.
2. Feet hip width, toes out maybe 10 degrees.
3. Hands just outside the legs, double overhand for warmups.
4. Hinge down: push the hips back first, then bend the knees until the hands reach the bar. Shins touch the bar.
5. Chest up, lats "put your armpits in your back pockets", take the slack out of the bar until it clicks against the plates.
6. Big breath into the belly, brace like someone is about to poke me.
7. Push the floor away.

## Rafael's cues
- "Push the floor away", not "pull the bar". This one fixed my hips shooting up.
- "Bend the bar around your shins" for the lats.
- "Stand tall, don't lean back at the top." I was hyperextending to show I'd finished, like a gymnast.
- "Reset every rep" for now, no touch and go until 100+ kg is boring.

## Mistakes I made
### Hips rising first
Weeks 1 to 3. The bar stayed on the floor while my butt went up, so it turned into a stiff-leg pull with a rounded back. Fix: slower off the floor, push the floor, and filming every top set from the side on my phone.

### Bar drifting forward
The bar swung out in front of the knees on heavier sets. Fix: lat cue, and dragging the bar up the legs. Bruised shins for a month, bought Rehband shin sleeves ($38).

### Grip failing
At 90 kg the bar rolled out of my right hand. Mixed grip (right hand under) for top sets now. Rafael wants me to learn the hook grip eventually but it hurts my thumbs a lot.

## Progress
| date | top set | notes |
|---|---|---|
| 2025-02-12 | 50 kg × 5 | first session, so light, so awkward |
| 2025-03-05 | 70 kg × 5 | hips still early on rep 5 |
| 2025-04-09 | 85 kg × 3 | first time with chalk |
| 2025-05-28 | 95 kg × 2 | mixed grip |
| 2025-06-21 | **102.5 kg × 1** | PR. 1.68 × bodyweight. Rafael yelled |

Since July it's maintenance: 5 × 3 at 85 kg on Wednesdays, because marathon training eats everything. Full weekly layout in [[Krafttraining Plan]].

## Accessories
- Romanian deadlift 3 × 8 at 60 kg, slow eccentric, hamstrings scream
- back extensions 3 × 12 bodyweight
- suitcase carries 4 × 20 m with the 24 kg bell
- kettlebell swings on Fridays, which use the same hinge but explosively, see [[Kettlebell swings]]. Deadlift is a grind from a dead stop, swings are a snap and float. Don't mix up the cues.

## Gear
- flat shoes: Vans Old Skool, the running shoes squish
- 10 mm lever belt, Inzer, borrowed from the YMCA rack, only above 90 kg
- chalk ball, $9
- no straps yet
